method: Sequential persistent loopback HTTP requests alternating between release Rust Tauri and production Flask routes in Waitress. RSS covers the entire server process and excludes children. Create, poll and download a Kechimochi CSV through production HTTP. Library includes 48 covers of 16 KiB each, activity includes daily rollups, live lines and imports, and incremental includes a modified historical sentence. Poll every millisecond. Compare entire CSV files and verify partial downloads, validation and cursor persistence.
